hints.title: Recursive Traversal Unwinding
hints.text: The immutable interface forbids modifying pointers, but natural call recursion unwinds elements from tail to head.

hints.title: Post-Order Output Timing
hints.text: Traverse recursively to the next node before invoking printValue on the current node.

hints.title: Block Partitioning for Constant Memory
hints.text: For sublinear space, count nodes and divide into sqrt(N) blocks, printing each block in reverse.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in the linked list
complexity.notes: Recursion stack holds N frames during the post-order unwinding phase.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Immutable interface prevents mutating next pointers to reverse the list in-place.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pure recursive post-order trades O(N) recursion memory for simple O(N) linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Post-order recursion or sqrt-decomposition for O(sqrt(N)) space.
